notes.title: The Latest from Astronomic Games!
notes.content:
The latest from Astronomic Games: Snares of Ruin!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/766940/Snares_of_Ruin/

You are detective Hank Anderson , and you’ve just been transferred to another city to help solve a series of unusual crimes. Upon arrival, you are greeted with a gory scene and a revelation of several instances of a deadly disease that turns people into savage zombie-like husks.

Grab it now at 30% off!

notes.title: Mercury: Cascade into Madness needs your help now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, please go and check out this great game on Greenlight and give it a thumbs up if you like it! 

With an urban sci-fi cyberpunk setting, Mercury takes place in a crime-ridden city where vigilante justice is a common occurrence with a choice and consequence aspect being a core part of the game's progression.

If this sounds interesting, please check it out on the link below! Everyone who's familiar with Astronomic games will know that they produce great games that are great fun and this is no exception! 

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=875866713

notes.title: Just Released on Steam, Atonement 2: Ruptured by Despair
notes.content:
The brand new Atonement 2: Ruptured by despair has just been released! For those of you who loved the first game, here comes the sequel, with even more great gameplay, story and characters! 

The last king was killed over 400 years ago and the global rule of the land ceased to exist. The Vindicator is coming. ~a decadent, dark fantasy world with a new take on the concepts of Angels and Demons! 
Click the link below if your interested then hurry, buy the game with a 30% launch discount and whittle hours completing it! 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/533820/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

If you haven't tried the first game and this sounds like your cup of tea, go check it out on the following link! 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/385070/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

notes.title: Astronomic Games' new title on Greenlight!
notes.content:
Astronomic Games' new title on Greenlight!

Hey, beautiful people! As the title suggests, this esteemed developer has a new title out on Greenlight, and they need your help!

Outrage is a short cyberpunk dungeon crawler. You manage a team of vigilantes and must undertake various missions in the city to strengthen your team and your cause in order to bring a powerful enemy to justice. However, you will not be able to undertake every single mission and therefore have to choose them wisely. 

You can check out the trailer and show your support over on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=628852621]Greenlight Campaign![/url]
